settingsHelp: Choose one clear store-wide delivery method. Existing sellers remain unavailable for checkout until this is configured.
enabledHelp: Buyers can request a quote for the countries below.
disabledHelp: Checkout stays blocked; no free or worldwide shipping is assumed.
carrierHelp: A label only; no carrier API is connected.
countriesHelp: Two-letter ISO codes separated by commas, for example FR, BE, DE.
destinationHelp: Enter the two-letter country code to confirm availability and price before payment.
destinationUnavailable: This seller does not ship to that destination.
notConfigured: This seller has not configured shipping yet.
